title: rosa micrantha var. lemanii
intro: Rosa micrantha var. lemanii, commonly known as the Dwarf Alpenrose or Alpine Rose, is a flowering plant species native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Rosa micrantha var. lemanii is reported to have therapeutic actions such as anti-hemorrhagic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Rosa micrantha var. lemanii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
